name: application-filters
title: Filters
description: Responsive filter components for sorting, searching, and refining content in ecommerce, dashboards, data tables, and search interfaces.
useWhen: Responsive filter components for sorting, searching, and refining content in ecommerce, dashboards, data tables, and search interfaces.
avoidWhen: Avoid filters when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Filters uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Native details and summary elements provide keyboard-accessible disclosure behavior.
Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
